name: Jármi (Hungary)
description: Red field with a white triangle at the hoist whose point reaches the fly, charged in the hoist with the municipal arms of Jármi (a red and green shield with a church, a sabre and a heart) below the name JÁRMI in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
